UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_header: Header MUST use high opacity crystal background (bg-[#070B14]/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-amber-500/15) so links never clash with content.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond / Playfair serif for all H1, H2, H3 to match the high-end medical consultancy tone.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_discipline: No bright neon blues or generic SaaS purple. Stick strictly to Obsidian Navy, Deep Slate, and Gold Champagne metallic accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_standard: Generous luxury spacing: py-24 to py-32 for sections, px-6 to px-12 for containers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.lenis_scrolling: Install and configure Lenis for seamless fluid momentum scrolling.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.all_data_testids: Every key button, link, and interactive widget must have clear kebab-case data-testid tags.
